knowledgeBase.title: Connecting via SFTP & SSH Keys
knowledgeBase.summary: How to connect FileZilla or WinSCP using your SSH public key and server SFTP port.
knowledgeBase.content: Open Account Settings -> SSH Keys to add your Ed25519 public key. Then open your server Settings page to copy the SFTP host and port (default 2022) and sign in with your panel username.

knowledgeBase.title: Securing Your Account with 2FA & Backup Codes
knowledgeBase.summary: Best practices for TOTP authenticator apps, backup recovery codes, and API IP allowlists.
knowledgeBase.content: Enable Two-Factor Authentication under Account Settings. Always store your backup recovery codes offline and restrict every Client API key to specific trusted IP addresses.

knowledgeBase.title: Fixing Minecraft EULA & Startup Flags
knowledgeBase.summary: Why Minecraft servers stop on first boot and how to accept /eula.txt in one click.
knowledgeBase.content: PaperMC and Vanilla servers require eula=true inside /eula.txt before starting. HelzerX automatically detects the EULA prompt in your console and lets you accept and boot immediately.

knowledgeBase.title: Using Wallet Credits, Coupons & Invoices
knowledgeBase.summary: How to top up your HelzerX wallet, apply promo codes, and download receipts.
knowledgeBase.content: Visit Billing -> Overview & Wallet to top up funds or redeem a coupon code like WELCOME10. All completed transactions automatically generate tax-itemized invoices you can print or export.
